mutations.name: the opponent's board draws this player's moves
mutations.why: The one thing the replay is for — how the opponent played — shows the player's own game under the opponent's name.
mutations.expectFailure: the opponent's board at the end is not the board their moves make

mutations.name: the board ignores the time bar
mutations.why: Dragging the time bar changes the clock and nothing else; the board stays on the finished game.
mutations.find: const { board, notes, last } = gridsAt(record.puzzle, events, at);
mutations.replace: const { board, notes, last } = gridsAt(record.puzzle, events, 0);
mutations.expectFailure: my board at the end is not the board my moves make

mutations.name: the opponent's board opens when there are no moves for it
mutations.why: A player whose opponent declined taps into an empty board, or one that silently shows their own.
mutations.expectFailure: can be opened although they declined

mutations.name: no reason is given for a missing opponent board
mutations.why: The player cannot tell a declined opponent from a bug.

mutations.name: mistakes are not marked on the time bar
mutations.why: The player has to play the whole replay to find the moment it went wrong.

mutations.name: play does not advance
mutations.why: The play button shows pause and nothing moves.
mutations.expectFailure: pressing play did not move the replay

mutations.name: back skips the replay
mutations.why: Back leaves the records screen for home while the replay stays on top of it — or, over a 1v1 result, leaves the room.
mutations.expectFailure: back did not close the replay

mutations.name: the summary does not fit a phone
mutations.why: Columns wider than the screen push the opponent's numbers off the edge.

mutations.name: a notice raised over the replay opens under it
mutations.why: Starring a 21st replay from inside the replay shows the limit message behind the replay; the star looks broken.
mutations.expectFailure: the star-limit message is not visible over the replay

mutations.name: the replay leaves no room for the banner
mutations.why: Opened from the 1v1 result, the last summary rows sit under the AdMob banner and cannot be scrolled into view.
